story.zh: 平定河北的袁绍从刘备口中得知衣带诏一事后，决定即刻发兵渡河，向南方挺进。
story.en: Having pacified Hebei, Yuan Shao learned of the Girdle Decree from Liu Bei and resolved to dispatch troops across the river at once to advance south.

trigger.zh: 曹操、关羽、袁绍、颜良、文丑、刘备存活。许昌属曹操，邺属袁绍。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Guan Yu, Yuan Shao, Yan Liang, Wen Chou, and Liu Bei are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao, and Ye belongs to Yuan Shao.
